title: NEAR Protocol: Why Smart Money Is Loading This Zone
description:
NEAR just hit $6B volume on Intents while trading near multi-year lows. Grayscale is loading, here's my complete setup. In this video, I break down why NEAR Protocol presents one of the most compelling risk-reward opportunities in crypto right now. You'll discover the explosive growth behind NEAR Intents, which just achieved record-breaking metrics including $3.5B monthly volume and $265M daily volume, all organic activity generating real fee revenue that buys back NEAR tokens directly.

I'll show you why Grayscale's Decentralized AI Fund allocated nearly 29% to NEAR as their second-largest position, and what the 460% surge in development activity signals about builder confidence. On the technical side, I analyze the multi-year symmetrical triangle forming since 2020, key Fibonacci levels, moving average structure, and Volume Profile data to identify my exact accumulation zone, stop loss levels, and staged take-profit targets ranging from $3.30 to $19.

Whether you're a swing trader looking for defined setups or a long-term investor seeking undervalued AI infrastructure plays, this analysis gives you the framework to make informed decisions.

asr.full_text: Nier Protocol just quietly crossed $6 billion in all-time volume on their Intense platform, and the price is still sitting near multi-year lows. Greyscale's decentralized AI fund holds Nier as their second-largest position, development activity spiked 460% in 30 days, and fee revenue is being used to buy back tokens directly from the market. Yet here we are trading under 22 while the fundamentals scream accumulation. I've been tracking NEAR for months now and what I'm seeing in both the data and the technicals tells me we might be looking at one of the most asymmetric opportunities in this market cycle. Let me show you exactly what I mean. NEAR is currently trading around 1$95. SITT, sitting near multi-year support levels after a brutal drawdown from its December 2024 highs above $8. The broader altcoin market has been struggling, but here's what separates Nair from the noise. The on-chain metrics and institutional positioning are completely diverging from the price action. We're witnessing a textbook accumulation setup where smart money is loading while retail sleeps on the opportunity. Let's break down what's actually happening, because these numbers deserve attention. Near and Tense just hit multiple all-time highs this weekend – $3.5 billion in monthly volume, $1.5 billion weekly, and $265 million in a single day. They've processed over 10 million total swaps. On November 22nd alone, NEAR recorded its single largest trading day ever, with 290 million in volume, and the team confirms this activity is organic, not incentivized farming. Now, here's what matters for token holders. NEAR Intents has generated over $10 million in fees, and that revenue flows directly into buying back Near tokens from the open market. This creates genuine buy pressure backed by real economic activity, not promises or roadmap slides. The user behavior evolution is equally telling. Eight days ago, stablecoins and Zcash dominated the volume. Now Bitcoin represents roughly 19% of daily transactions, making it the second largest asset being swapped through the platform. When whales start routing Bitcoin through your infrastructure, that signals serious institutional confidence in the technology. The expansion continues aggressively. Monad integration went live from day one, enabling users to swap over 120 assets across major chains directly into MON tokens without bridging. Zcash now accounts for 13% of facilitated volume at 587 million since September. This multi-chain interoperability is exactly what the market needs as liquidity fragments across dozens of ecosystems. Now here's the institutional validation that most people are missing. Greyscale's decentralized AI fund allocates nearly 29% to Near ecosystems. Now, here's the institutional validation that most people are missing. Grayscale's decentralized AI fund allocates nearly 29 percent to Nier, their second-largest position behind only BitTensor. Combined, TAU and Nier represent over 61 percent of this fund's total exposure. When traditional finance builds AI-focused crypto products, they're choosing Nier as core infrastructure. This is defintely not speculation about future AI integration. NEAR is actively positioning as the chain abstraction layer that AI agents will use to interact across blockchains. The development activity supports this thesis. Chainbroker data shows NEAR ranking fourth in development growth, with 460% increase over 30 days. That's builders shipping code while the price consolidates. Now, let's examine the chart because this is where the setup crystallizes. On the two week timeframe, NEAR is forming a textbook symmetrical triangle that has been developing since 2020. The upper boundary descends from that January 2022 all time high around around $20, with clear rejections in March 2022 and December 2024. The lower boundary ascends from the October 2020 all-time low near $0.50, retested in October 2023 and again recently in September. Price is coiling inside this multi-year structure approaching the apex. Inside this larger triangle, there's a more immediate descending trend line from the December 2024 top that's been respected with rejections in September and November. Nir currently trades below this descending resistance on its pre-counter-back trend line. Breaking above it would be our first bullish signal. The moving averages confirm the downtrend. Price sits below the 10 EMAs, are when quality assets get accumulated at discount prices. The Heikin-Nashi RSI hovers between neutral and oversold, pointing slightly downward, but not yet at capitulation levels. The volume profile shows point of control around $2.25, acting as a price magnet. We're trading at value — exactly where large players build positions. My Fibonacci analysis anchors from the December 2024 high at $8.30 down to the recent low at $1.75. The 2-3-6 retracement at $3.30 has rejected price since March. That's my first resistance target. Here's my strategy. My accumulation zone spans $1.60-$2.40. Stop loss for short term positions sits at $1.40. A weekly close below invalidates this structure. For longer-term holdings, I would reaccumulate around $1 on a breakdown. My take profit targets… $3.30 first. $5 at triangle resistance, $6.90 at the 786 extension, $12 at the 1618, and $19 as my moon bag near the 2618 level. I trail stops as targets hit to protect profits while letting winners run. Risk reward here is compelling. A move from $2.00 to $5.00 delivers 150% gains with defined downside. Best case? Multi hundred percent rally on a Triangle Breakout. Worst case? Re-test of $1.00 support, which becomes a better accumulation zone. What changes my thesis? Sustained breakdown below $1.40 combined with declining on-chain metrics. Changes My Thesis Sustained Breakdown BELOW $1.4 Combined with Declining On-Chain Metrics Nier is delivering institutional-grade AI infrastructure with real revenue, organic adoption, and aggressive development, all while trading Nier multi-year support. The fundamentals and technicals are aligning for patient investors. If this breakdown provided value, hit that like button and subscribe for more daily setups. Join my free Telegram group for faster updates. Link in the pinned comment. Thanks for watching. Never financial advice, and I'll see you in the next one.
